items.title: 13.4 Oxidising agents ke taur par halogens ki nisbati reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.4 with Table 13.4 and Quick Check 13.2, printed pages 294-295.

blocks.text: Tamam free (azad) halogens jab metals aur zyada tar non-metals se react karte hain to oxidizing agent (doosre se electron lene wala) ka kaam karte hain. Metals ke saath ionic compounds banate hue halogens electrons le lete hain aur negative halide ions ban jate hain.

Halogens ki oxidizing power (electron lene ki taqat) group mein neeche jate hue kam hoti hai. Fluorine ki oxidizing power sab se zyada aur iodine ki sab se kam hai. Oxidizing agent ke taur par ghat-ti taqat ki tarteeb yeh hai:

Halogens ki reactivity seedhi is baat se judi hai ke doosre elements se react karte hue woh kitni aasani se electron le kar halide ions (F⁻, Cl⁻, Br⁻ aur I⁻) banate hain. Fluorine mein electron le kar fluoride banne ka rujhan sab se zyada hai. Fluorine molecule tamam halide ions (Cl⁻, Br⁻ aur I⁻) ko un ke solutions mein oxidize kar ke un ki jagah le leta hai (displace karta hai) aur woh free halogens ban jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne yeh teenon equations balanced nahi chhapi: F₂(g) + Cl¹⁻(aq) → F¹⁻(aq) + Cl₂(g) waghaira. Ek F₂ molecule do F⁻ ions banata hai aur do halide ions se do electrons leta hai, is liye dono taraf 2 lagta hai. Oopar sahi (balanced) equations di gayi hain.
Isi tarah chlorine Br⁻ aur I⁻ ko oxidize aur displace kar sakti hai. Bromine sirf I⁻ ko oxidize aur displace kar sakti hai. Iodine kisi halide ion ko oxidize nahi kar sakti.

Halogens ki oxidizing power ko standard electrode potential (E°) se joda ja sakta hai. Fluorine sab se reactive halogen aur sab se taqatwar oxidizing agent hai. Table 13.4 mein halogens ke E° (X₂/X⁻) fluorine se iodine tak kam positive hote jate hain; yeh ghat-ti oxidizing power ko dikhata hai. Oxidizing power kai cheezon par depend karti hai: dissociation energy (X₂ ko atoms mein todne ki energy), atoms ki electron affinity (electron lene par nikalne wali energy), ions ki hydration energy (ion ke gird pani ke molecules judne par nikalne wali energy), aur Br₂ aur I₂ ke liye heat of vaporization. Jis halogen ki dissociation energy kam, electron affinity zyada aur us ke ions ki hydration energy zyada ho, us ki oxidizing power zyada hoti hai.

header: Kin ions ko displace karta hai

blocks.prompt: a) Fluorine sab se zyada electronegative element hai, phir bhi F–F bond Cl–Cl bond se kamzor kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye F–F bond bohat chhota hai aur dono atoms ke lone pairs ek doosre ke bohat qareeb aa kar zor se repel karte hain. Yeh repulsion bond ko kamzor kar deta hai: F₂ ki bond energy 156 kJ mol⁻¹ hai jab ke Cl₂ ki 243 kJ mol⁻¹. Chlorine ke atoms bare hain, is liye lone pairs door rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Kya NaCl(aq) aur F₂ gas ka reaction mumkin hai? Haan ya nahi ki wajah dein, aur haan ho to equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Haan. Fluorine chlorine se taqatwar oxidizing agent hai (E° +2.87 V, jab ke chlorine ka +1.36 V), is liye woh Cl⁻ ko oxidize kar ke chlorine nikal deti hai: F₂(g) + 2NaCl(aq) → 2NaF(aq) + Cl₂(g). (Asal mein fluorine pani se bhi react karti hai.)

blocks.prompt: c) Halogens ki oxidizing power aur un ke standard reduction potential ka kya taalluq hai?
blocks.explanation: X₂/X⁻ ka E° jitna zyada positive, X₂ utni aasani se electron leta hai, yani utna taqatwar oxidizing agent hai. E° F₂ (+2.87) > Cl₂ (+1.36) > Br₂ (+1.07) > I₂ (+0.54), aur oxidizing power bhi isi tarteeb mein hai.

items: Halogens electrons le kar oxidize karte hain: 2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl.
Oxidizing power F₂ > Cl₂ > Br₂ > I₂; E° +2.87, +1.36, +1.07, +0.54 V.
Har halogen apne se neeche wale halide ions ko displace karta hai: F₂ + 2Cl⁻ → 2F⁻ + Cl₂.
Kam dissociation energy, zyada electron affinity aur zyada hydration energy: zyada oxidizing power.
